summary: FedEx Freight Holding Company filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026, announcing that its first annual meeting of stockholders will be held May 5, 2027. The filing sets Rule 14a-8 proposal and advance-notice windows: proposals due by November 24, 2026, bylaws notice between January 5 and February 4, 2027, and proxy-access nominations December 6, 2026 through January 5, 2027, for holders of 3% for three years nominating up to 20% of directors. No transaction, stake, price, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; this is routine meeting scheduling.
